people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
translations.bsb: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.
translations.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
translations.asv: And I know that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of Christ.
